22:15 │ A CONTINUACIÓN: College Football
The Colorado Buffaloes host the No. 11 Utah Utes in Week 7 at Folsom Field. Utah beat Kansas 41-24 to remain unbeaten at 5-0. Devon Dampier threw for 238 yards and 3 touchdowns. Colorado looks to bounce back after a tough stretch in Big 12 action.
